title: Entertainment Head End Chassis — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the entertainment head end chassis, including the software load, the rack ventilation check and a functional check across at least ten seat groups on each deck.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of the entertainment head end chassis in its rack, the loading of its software standard and the functional check that closes the installation.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm which chassis generation is to be fitted, because the retainers, the partition and the software standard all differ. The second generation chassis needs the ventilated upper partition; do not install it against the original partition, since the rack will run hot at full cabin load. Have the portable data loader and the correct media set at the aircraft before you start.
sections.procedure: Confirm that the distribution is still isolated and that the warning notice is in place. Inspect the rack rails and clean the connector faces. Install the upper partition, using the ventilated item D4420125490996 for a second generation chassis, and secure it with anchor nuts EN258434K3. Fit the rack lifting handles to the chassis and slide it into the rack with two persons. CAUTION: DO NOT FORCE THE CHASSIS ONTO ITS CONNECTORS. IF IT DOES NOT SEAT WITH HAND PRESSURE, WITHDRAW IT AND CHECK THE RAIL ALIGNMENT. Engage the retainers and torque them to the value in the illustration. Connect the data and power connectors. Refit the galley insert at FIN 7RK6 and the rack front cover. Remove the warning notice and restore the distribution. WARNING: DO NOT PUT YOUR HAND INTO THE RACK AFTER THE DISTRIBUTION HAS BEEN RESTORED. THE FEEDER IS LIVE AND THE VENTILATION FANS RUN WITHOUT WARNING. Connect the portable data loader and load the applicable software standard, then confirm the reported part number. Measure the rack outlet air temperature after twenty minutes at full cabin load and confirm that it is inside the limit. Do a functional check on at least ten seat groups on each deck, including the seat display and the seat power outlet.
sections.close_out: Remove the portable data loader and close the data loading panel. Update the aircraft software configuration list with the loaded part number. Record the rack outlet temperature and the seat groups checked. Close the technical log entry made at removal and confirm that no cabin maintenance message is present.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Use the ventilated upper partition and the built-in test software standard for the second generation chassis.

safety_precautions: Keep the distribution isolated until the chassis is fully installed.
Do not put your hand into the rack after the distribution is restored.
Use two persons for the lift.
